Couldn't be happier.
I have a German Shepherd puppy who is now 7 months old, my first dog. I have received good follow-up and have been able to answer good and not so good questions from us. The puppy likes it there.
Recommended!

Always fantastic help and plenty of time for the dogs. Audun explains, shows and my dog ​​almost doesn't want to leave after the visit. The prices are also nothing to write home about! Reasonable compared to many others. Highly recommended to use this vet!

Vetnor and veterinarian Audun can be highly recommended. We have two Labrador boys, 11 and 7 years old, both patients with Audun when necessary. We have recently had an upgrade of the dental status of our oldest. First we had a dental cleaning because he had a bad breath. It showed that it was necessary to extract 3 teeth that had started to rot (we saw the teeth after the extraction). We want the beautiful boy to also have a great life in recent years and Audun has performed both the dental cleaning and the extraction in a cost-effective and professional manner and you are very warmly taken care of. He is the "regular veterinarian" who does not charge "chain prices".

We have decided on an annual dental cleaning for the oldest (maybe both) so that his last 1-2-3 years of life will be as good as the first 11 if possible. Let the regular veterinarian take a dental status of your dog as naturally as we owners go to our GP with our health problems. Remember that our beloved animals cannot tell us when they are in pain (toothache).

Very welcoming and helpful! Took plenty of time to explain the different processes with regard to various necessary treatments - what is happening and why you should address it - while also clarifying the severity ("no need to worry, but address it in the long run"). Showed care for the dog, as well as being a pleasant and knowledgeable man. Left the class calm and with a greater understanding of the dog's health. Absolutely a good experience!

Audun is a very skilled veterinarian. He is calm and professional in all situations😊
Highly recommended☺️ …
Nice and good atmosphere, professional and skilled. Will be happy to return.
Nice and competent veterinarian at a cozy and modern clinic!
Easily accessible, short waiting time. Good advice and follow-up.

A very nice experience at the vet. Took a lot of time, and explained along the way. This makes me want to use this animal clinic for my dog ​​in the future. Five stars without a doubt, and can be highly recommended 🤩 …
Highly recommend. Incredibly skilled veterinarian who took great time with my dog, and much more affordable than the most popular chains.
Very skilled veterinarian. Took plenty of time during consultation. Highly recommend!
